summary: Atmos Energy filed an 8-K reporting completion of a $700 million public offering of 6.000% senior notes due November 15, 2036, issued under its existing Form S-3 shelf via a prospectus supplement dated October 6, 2026. Net proceeds were approximately $691.4 million after underwriting discount and estimated expenses. The notes are unsecured senior obligations ranking pari passu with other unsubordinated debt, pay interest semi-annually beginning May 15, 2027, and are redeemable at the company's option at make-whole-style prices. Covenants limit liens, sale-leasebacks, mergers and asset sales. This is a routine debt capital-markets takedown, not a special situation.
